lines.en: I wander this area.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，几乎没声
lines.en: My steps are light, almost silent.
I chase no one; I merely walk.
My teeth show; they will not close.
I circle the old yard.
My shadow turns with me.
Broken boards creak under me.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为我不赶时间
lines.en: I walk slowly; I am not in a hurry.
I head toward the light.
This body is heavier than it looks.
I am missing one ear.
I go around the puddles.
I look around and find nothing.

lines.zh: 我站在阴影里，眼睛发光
lines.en: I stand in shadow with glowing eyes.

lines.zh: 我的身体有撕裂的痕迹
lines.en: There are tears across my body.
I will stand here until dawn.
I do not attack; I simply exist.
My claws hang at my sides.
The wind here is cold.
I am counting the ticking.
My head tilts; I have not moved in a while.

lines.zh: 我身上有旧地毯的味道
lines.en: I smell of old carpet.
I blinked once, slowly.
My fingers tap lightly.
This place used to be busy.
I never have to close my eyes.
You have walked into my yard.
My eyes are the brightest thing here.
Keep still; let me finish looking.
The living smell is on you.
I neither approach nor leave.
My teeth look white in the light.
You should not have come to this biome.
I see you counting my teeth.
Three steps separate us.
I face you without moving.
Your fear is reasonable.
My face is sewn badly.
Look too long and you will dream.
I tilted my head at you.
The door behind you is open.
A patch of my fabric tore.
I do not cry out; I cannot.
That knocked me crooked.
My stuffing spilled out.
You hit harder than I expected.
One of my teeth came loose.
I stand, and do not retreat.
This damage does not stop me.

lines.zh: 你听见线断裂的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the stitching snap?
I will keep walking.
I do not eat and never hunger.
You have held that up a long while.
I look at it, but do not reach.
My mouth will not close.
That means nothing to me.
I prefer watching you hold it.
Lower your hand.
My interest is not in food.
Even if it falls, I will not pick it up.
You stepped into my spot.
I will not step aside for you.
Our collision made no sound.
This shell is hard.
Take two steps back.
I do not chase; you need not run.
After the bump, I am still watching you.
You stepped on my foot.
This hallway is too narrow.
I am only an empty shell.
There is nothing in here like a heart.
I will not answer that.
You should leave this place.
My stillness is my answer.
Such questions make me quiet.
Only shadows interest me.
I do not have what you ask for.
Not here, not this.
I have never needed company.

lines.zh: 我不用捡，东西会自己到我这
lines.en: I need not pick up; things come to me.
What you dropped is over there.
I do not intend to bend down.
I lower my head to look at it.
This thing is far too light.
I nudged it with my foot.
You had better take it yourself.
It reminds me of an old toy.
I do not want to touch it at all.
My gaze has settled on you.
I do not shout, nor run.
I will follow you the whole way.
You start running, and so do I.
This place has no exit.
You are getting closer to me.
I remember where you came from.
The music should start now.
I am in the corner you cannot see.
Do not turn off the light; I get closer.
I am giving you five minutes.
I have already begun counting.
Hiding in the cupboard will not help.
I like this game.
I hear you through the walls.
You moved to another room.
I move slowly, but I do not stop.
Your torchlight brushed me.
One more step closer.
I am at the end of the hall.
You count doors; I count you.
A locked door will not stop me.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，所以没有声音
lines.en: I do not breathe, so I make no sound.
Do you hear the drums?

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就在走廊里
lines.en: Look back; I am in the hall.
This building is mine.
You are running a little fast.
Do not run up the stairs.
I will wait at the bottom of the stairs.
Your shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离在减少
lines.en: The distance between us is shrinking.
I have always been on this floor.
My teeth arrive first.
There is little weight behind this.
My claws scraped you.
I am not angry; I only comply.
You are at the foot of the wall.
My arm swings stiffly.
You blocked it; I am still here.
I caught your shoulder.
This blow made no sound.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿合不上，只能撞
lines.en: My jaw will not close; I can only ram.
You are shoved backward.
One more swing like that.
My force is just enough to hurt.
Do not stand against the wall.
I stopped because you retreated.
This body is not nimble.
I woke up in this biome.

lines.zh: 我一直在这里，只是你刚看见
lines.en: I was always here; you just saw me.
Blacktomb Yard is my ground.
I rise from under the torn cloth.

lines.zh: 灯光闪了一下，我就到了
lines.en: The light flickered, and I was there.

lines.zh: 这地方多了一个不该有的
lines.en: Something that should not be is here.
Do you hear the music box?

lines.zh: 我站在风车马戏团边上
lines.en: I stand by Pinwheel Circus.
I am tall; you can see me clearly.
I have no spawn egg, yet I am here.
The grass in the yard is flattened.
I come out from behind an old poster.

lines.zh: 你一个人来这儿，胆子不小
lines.en: Coming here alone takes nerve.

lines.zh: 这里以前有过别的东西
lines.en: Something else used to be here.
I have made this my home.

lines.zh: 你身后的门自己关上了
lines.en: The door behind you closed by itself.
I turn around, slowly.
My fabric burns with a strange smell.
I fell downstairs and parts scattered.
Water fills my hollow shell.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的填充物炸飞
lines.en: The blast blew out my stuffing.
An arrow passed through my belly.
The spell holds me still.
I have no stomach, yet feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷把我的轮廓照得很清楚
lines.en: Lightning made my outline sharp.
This dark is deeper than mine.
